fields.description: What the job does, e.g. Provision n1.blr.frappemail.com. Set by the action that created it.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Kind of server the playbook runs against: a Stalwart Node of a cluster or an Egress Gateway.
fields.label: Server Type

fields.description: The node or gateway the playbook runs against, over SSH with the cluster's key.
fields.label: Server

fields.description: Ansible playbook in the app's provisioning folder, e.g. bootstrap-cluster.yml or upgrade-stalwart.yml. Its task names fill the Tasks table when the job is created.
fields.label: Playbook

fields.description: Pending: waiting for a worker. Running: the playbook is executing and the Tasks table fills in live. Success: every task passed and the callback ran. Failed: a task failed, the server was unreachable or the callback raised; see Error.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Failed attempts so far. Increases each time the job ends in Failed.
fields.label: Retries

fields.description: Automatic retries the scheduler may make after a failure, every 5 minutes, unless a newer job exists for the same server. Retry from the form works regardless.
fields.label: Max Retries

fields.description: When a worker picked the job up. Reset on every retry.
fields.label: Started At

fields.description: When the playbook finished or the job failed.
fields.label: Ended At

fields.description: Seconds between Started At and Ended At.
fields.label: Duration (s)

fields.description: Tasks that ran without error, including those that changed nothing.
fields.label: OK

fields.description: Tasks that changed something on the server.
fields.label: Changed

fields.description: Tasks that failed. One is enough to fail the job.
fields.label: Failures

fields.description: Tasks that could not reach the server over SSH. One is enough to fail the job.
fields.label: Unreachable

fields.description: Tasks skipped by their condition, or failed with errors ignored.
fields.label: Skipped

fields.description: One row per task of the playbook, in run order, with its status, timing and output. Updated live while the job runs and reset on Retry.
fields.label: Tasks

fields.description: Dotted path of the function that builds the playbook variables from the context when the job runs, e.g. suite_cloud.cluster.bootstrap.build_node_variables. Secrets are fetched then, never stored.
fields.label: Variables Builder

fields.description: Method of the server document run when the job ends: this name on success, the same name with _failed on failure, e.g. after_provision and after_provision_failed. If it raises, the job is marked Failed.
fields.label: Callback

fields.description: Inputs the builder needs, as JSON: document names and ids only, never secrets.
fields.label: Context

fields.description: What the playbook received, secrets shown as ***. Written when the job starts, so a retry refreshes it.
fields.label: Variables

fields.description: Why the job failed: the Ansible summary with the tail of its output, or the traceback of the callback. Secrets masked; cleared when the job starts again.
fields.label: Error Log
